tagline: The global leader in diagnostics and information technology for companion animal, livestock, poultry, and water quality health.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI represents the majority of the company's revenue (79% in 2025) and is considered highly profitable and sustainable, with gross margins significantly higher than instrument sales. It is the primary driver of the company's growth and valuation.

kpis.name: Recurring Diagnostic Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from regular sales of consumables, tests, and laboratory services.
kpis.description: Represents the portion of revenue derived from ongoing sales of products and services essential to veterinary practice (VetLab consumables, SNAP tests, reference laboratory services, maintenance agreements), as opposed to one-time instrument sales.
kpis.signal: A high proportion of recurring revenue ensures stability and predictability of financial cash flows.

kpis.name: Installed Base Instrument
kpis.explanation: Total number of veterinary diagnostic instruments installed at customer sites.
kpis.description: The number of diagnostic instruments (Catalyst: 78K, Premium Hematology: 56K, SediVue Dx: 24K, IDEXX inVue Dx: 6K) deployed at veterinary clinics, which are essential for generating recurring revenue.
kpis.signal: A growing installed base is a key indicator of future demand for associated consumables and services.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: The direct profitability of products and services sold, influenced by the mix between instrument sales (non-recurring, low margins) and consumables/services (recurring, high margins).
kpis.signal: Recurring revenues, such as consumables, have significantly higher gross margins than instrument sales.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Measures the profitability of the company's core operations after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Growth in recurring revenue and operational efficiency gains in laboratories contribute to margin improvement.

kpis.name: R&D (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Indicates the level of investment the company makes in developing new technologies and products for the animal health market.
kpis.signal: Continuous innovation in instruments and tests is critical to maintaining product differentiation and justifying premium pricing.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures for the acquisition or upgrade of physical assets.
kpis.description: Spending dedicated to purchasing fixed assets, such as laboratory equipment and IT infrastructure, necessary for business operations and expansion.
kpis.signal: Investments in laboratory capacity and technological infrastructure support growth in services and products.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: The total number of people employed by IDEXX Laboratories, reflecting the size of the organization and its operational capacity.
kpis.signal: Expansion of the field sales organization has led to an increase in revenue opportunities.

kpis.name: Installed Base Instrument
kpis.explanation: Total number of veterinary diagnostic instruments installed at customer sites.
kpis.description: The number of diagnostic instruments (Catalyst: 78K, Premium Hematology: 56K, SediVue Dx: 24K, IDEXX inVue Dx: 6K) deployed at veterinary clinics, which are essential for generating recurring revenue.
kpis.signal: Continued growth in the installed base of instruments is a key driver for increasing recurring revenue and customer retention.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical risks due to its international operations, which could negatively impact its business, financial condition, and operating results. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Rate Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: A strengthening of the U.S. dollar exchange rate could have a negative effect on the company's business. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Inflation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to inflation risks, which could increase its costs and impact profitability. In 2025, the company experienced inflationary pressures on operating costs. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has a revolving credit facility maturing in 2030, but individual borrowings have maturities of less than one year. Outstanding borrowings as of December 31, 2025: $398 million. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Customs Tariff Risks
risks.score_rationale: Customs tariffs on imported goods could increase the company's costs. The company anticipates additional tariffs on imported goods in 2026. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Competition Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces competition in international markets, which could impact its market share and profitability. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, which could impact the confidentiality and integrity of its customers' data. (not explicitly mentioned in the text)

ai_positioning.summary: IDXX does not have significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts from the 10-K/20-F filing.
